@pytest.mark.parametrize('stdin', [{}], indirect=['stdin'])
def test_warn(am, capfd):

    am.deprecate('deprecation2', '2.3')

    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
        am.exit_json(deprecations=['deprecation3', ('deprecation4', '2.4')])
